mitre_mapping.relevance: Uses standard HTTP/HTTPS fetch APIs to initiate external communications.
Retrieves external data or code based on event instructions.

llm_evaluation.summary: The package 'awesome-tools-collection' exhibits suspicious network behavior by processing incoming event objects and executing arbitrary HTTP fetch requests using parameter data derived directly from event messages. This functionality strongly mirrors known malware samples like defca and zwhrce, posing severe risk of remote payload fetching or unauthorized data exfiltration.
